The variable I'm targeting is shown below. [IMAGE] Here's what I've attempted: [IMAGE] I assumed that since the parameter is a BCD word, publishing the same format would work, but it didn't. I also tried sending a decimal value with no success. Any suggestions or advice would be very helpful!

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble determining the correct data format needed to transmit a variable value to a PLC through MQTT while using AWS. Previous efforts with both BCD and decimal formats have not produced results, and a lack of clear guidance is making configuration challenging.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for explicit instructions or documentation that explains exactly how data must be formatted to successfully write a value to a PLC variable via MQTT.
